about: Every key agreement_create.py reads from an agreement's data file. The builder stops on a key that is not here, on a value of another shape, and on a Cover Page term the chosen standard does not have (skills/_shared/spec_guard.py). What the parties agreed that the standard's Cover Page has no field for goes in modifications, in their own words; a plain agreement ("clauses") is the parties' own words throughout.

hints.date: the agreement's date is "effective_date": a date (2026-11-01), or "last signature" when it takes effect as the last party signs
hints.law: the governing law is "governing_law", the parties' own choice: never fill it in; one they did not give goes in "unknown"
hints.jurisdiction: the courts are "courts", the parties' own choice: never fill them in; when they did not say, "unknown": ["courts"]
hints.parties.vat_id: a party is named by name, registration and address: write a VAT number into "registration" beside the register number
